# Kyra Shelf Guard

> Four-workstream Python project for SKU-independent suspicious shelf-removal alerts from replayable RGB-D input. The repository is an early foundation, not a completed end-to-end system.

The controlling assignment wins over summaries. Shared contracts are proposal-first and Person 4-owned; all affected owners must approve. Agents must read `AGENTS.md` and run repository consistency checks before editing.

## Audience Start

- [Documentation Hub](docs/README.md): map of audience paths and authoritative
  technical documents.
- [Plain-English Team Guide](docs/people/README.md): Purpose, honest progress, roles, limits, and a short glossary.
- [Team Getting Started](docs/people/GETTING_STARTED.md): Simple joining and contribution path.
- [Agent Documentation Route](docs/agents/README.md): Task-based route to technical authority.
